//: Fixed minimum coverage, only where money and safety live (owner decision, 28 Sep 2026, issue #118). Each floor is the value measured on 28 Sep 2026 rounded down to the nearest 5%. Go counts statements; test files are not counted. There is no repo-wide percentage.

pricing.//: Pricing and money: the server prices every order, in integer cents. Measured 84.7%.

ledger.//: Ledger: the double-entry postings every order's money must sum to zero in. Measured 100%.

order state machine.//: Order state machine: which transitions are legal and when each state times out. Measured 64.1%.

auth.//: Auth: phone OTP, password + TOTP, sessions, the deny-by-default role matrix. Measured 16.5%.

payments.//: Payments: authorise, capture, void, refunds, payouts, Stripe webhooks. Measured 14.4%.
